"I started making bouquets on my kitchen table for friends' birthdays. FloralsByZaee is that same table, just a little bigger."

Every bouquet is hand-rolled from ribbon, foam, or soft chenille — flowers that keep their colour and shape long after fresh ones would fade, so the gift lasts as long as the memory.

Each piece can be built around you: a name band, fairy lights, a favourite character, or a keepsake tucked into the wrap. Nothing leaves the table the same way twice.

— Zaee
